scenarios.title: Exercise ordinary transportation and order controls

requirement_mappings.note: The P0 FOM declares TckInteraction with HLAreliable transportation; the portable scenario queries its initial class transportation and asserts HLAreliable. This is one fixture/class witness.
The portable scenario requests HLAbestEffort and asserts the single Confirm Interaction Transportation Type Change callback identifies that achieved type.

In HLA_EVOKED, an interaction sent before confirmation uses HLAreliable; after the confirmation callback is invoked, a later send uses HLAbestEffort. HLA_IMMEDIATE confirms before the subsequent send. This is bounded to one interaction class and transition.

scenarios.mapping_note: Direct Java public-API witnesses mirror cpp-tck.transport-order. The adapter-supplied hla.rti.tck.transportOrderDefaultFom fixture declares TckObject.Value as HLAbestEffort; two joined federates each register an object and query that FOM default (§6.25 and §6.27). The base FOM path checks default and per-instance transport requests, full two-attribute confirmation payloads, class-default changes affecting a later instance, query callbacks, and the unowned Name attribute report matching its FOM-declared HLAreliable type (§§6.25–6.29). Interaction checks cover the initial reliable query result, the HLAbestEffort confirmation, a send before confirmation and a send after confirmation in both callback models, and the queried resulting type (§§6.30, 6.30, 6.31, 6.32, 6.33). The mapped §6.1.11 assertions check transportation values in the attribute request/confirmation path; unchanged-type interaction confirmation remains supplemental. Order-control calls and the valid-but-unpublished interaction-order rejection are supplemental and unmapped. C++ invalid-handle boundaries are omitted because the official Java API provides no portable invalid handle values; Java OrderType also has no equivalent to the C++ invalid enum cast. Focused runs use the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 Java API and local Umbra JNI provider; independent-provider behavior and conformance are not claimed.
